title: Fuaran ThemeManifest
description: A DTCG-compatible theme token contract extended with role bindings and soft-weighted invariants. The machine-readable contract an AI reasons against and the StyleObserver verifies against. The `tokens` block is a DTCG group tree; `roles` and `invariants` are the Fuaran extensions DTCG lacks. A vanilla DTCG file (the token tree at top level, no wrapper) is also accepted by the decoder.

tokens.description: DTCG group tree. A leaf is an object carrying `$value` (+ optional `$type` / `$description` / `$extensions`); any other object is a group whose non-`$`-prefixed children are nested tokens.

role.description: SPEC dual-field semantic tag — a free-form role name for the token.
The role bound. Absent decodes to the anonymous named role `{"named":""}`, and the canonical encoding omits that one value.

named.description: A named (non-tone) semantic role — page surface, body text, divider, etc.

token.description: The dotted token name this role resolves to (must exist under `tokens`).

invariant.description: One declared invariant. Every member but `kind` is OPTIONAL and carries its `default`: the canonical encoding every host writes omits a member at its default (the cross-host byte law), and a decoder supplies the default for an absent one. Whether a decoded invariant MEANS anything is not a schema question: a validation pass run after decode reports a contrast floor outside [1, 21], an empty or unbound role, a budget on an undeclared token and an unknown kind, with one shared code table (WIRE_FORMAT section 13, the style-observer family's `manifest-validation` tier).

kind.description: Closed here for AUTHORING. A decoder does not close it: an invariant whose kind it does not know is kept with its members, round-trips, and is reported as unenforced (`INVARIANT_KIND_UNKNOWN`), never silently dropped.

weight.description: Soft weight; learning of weights is deferred to a later phase.

role.description: ContrastFloor: the role (a tone name or a named role) whose contrast is floored. Must be non-empty and bound by a role binding.

minRatio.description: ContrastFloor: the floor, within [1, 21], the range WCAG's contrast formula produces. The default 0 is the decoded value of an absent member and is out of range: a floor below 1 passes every pair.

token.description: UsageBudget: the dotted name of a token declared under `tokens`.

maxDurationMs.description: MotionVoice: 0 is legitimate and strict — no motion.
